policy.goal: Make Claude-dispatched tool requests safe for Codex by checking parity before accepting the task.
never_do: pretend a Claude-only tool is callable from Codex
install paid APIs or metered services without explicit free/no-cost confirmation
create direct-session Claude handoff files unless the user asks

priority_tools.name: printing-press
priority_tools.repair_hint: Go is required for Printing Press Go CLIs. Install Go or configure a bundled Go path, then install/generate PP CLIs.

priority_tools.name: browser
priority_tools.repair_hint: Follow web skill routing. Codex now has pinned chrome-devtools MCP 1.9.0 configured with an isolated headless browser and usage statistics disabled. A new Codex session is required to expose it. Never attach personal browser profiles.

priority_tools.name: github
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the GitHub CLI (`gh`, keyring-authed as <your-github>; works for Claude and Codex alike); the Codex github@openai-curated-remote connector is the secondary route.

priority_tools.name: vercel
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the official npx route (`npx -y vercel@latest <cmd> --scope <your-team>`).

priority_tools.name: supabase
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the official npx route (`npx supabase ...`) or install the standalone/Scoop CLI. Do not use unsupported global npm install.

priority_tools.name: obsidian
priority_tools.repair_hint: Codex can write the local markdown vault directly. MCP parity is optional; do not dump non-durable session logs.

priority_tools.name: gemini
priority_tools.repair_hint: Codex should use the local Gemini MCP bridge when configured; otherwise hand back Gemini-only long-context tasks.

priority_tools.name: google-workspace
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use document/spreadsheet plugins for local files. Mail connectors draft only, never send.

priority_tools.name: openai-sites
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the installed Sites plugin for site builds and hosting; keep project-orchestrator for multi-mechanic projects.

priority_tools.name: web
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the web CLI and its mirrored Codex skill; do not invoke browser automation or scraping tools directly.

priority_tools.name: motion
priority_tools.repair_hint: Shared lane: skill symlinked into ~/.claude/skills/motion and ~/.codex/skills/motion; CLI ~/.local/bin/motion -> _tools/motion/bin/motion.mjs (run `npm i` in _tools/motion if playwright-core is missing). Smoke test: `npm test` in _tools/motion.

priority_tools.name: lane
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use ~/.local/bin/lane for admitted bounded text work.

priority_tools.name: open-loops
priority_tools.repair_hint: Claude drives the Workflow; Codex executes only dispatched items.

priority_tools.name: handoff-v2
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use python3 -m handoff.cli; do not run production hooks as a parity check.

priority_tools.name: freellmapi
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the configured HTTP route; credentials are never stored in this registry.

priority_tools.name: computer-use-linux
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the configured MCP only when the task requires native computer control.

priority_tools.name: desk-control
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the configured MCP only when the task requires native computer control.

priority_tools.name: firefox-devtools
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the configured Firefox DevTools MCP when it is exposed.

priority_tools.name: vault-rag
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the configured vault-rag MCP for vault retrieval.

priority_tools.name: herdr
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the configured herdr MCP when it is exposed.

priority_tools.name: scrapling (superseded)
priority_tools.repair_hint: Superseded by web; use web scrape rather than a direct Scrapling wrapper.

priority_tools.name: blender-mcp
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use only when Blender is installed/running and the blender-mcp bridge is exposed. Otherwise report that the GUI/socket is not ready.

priority_tools.name: ltx-2
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the local ltx2 workflow command only when models/GPU path are ready. Do not download weights or spend GPU without explicit ask.

priority_tools.name: voicebox
priority_tools.repair_hint: Content-forge writes the script first; use voicebox only as an explicit audio render helper when available.

priority_tools.name: get-windows (superseded)
priority_tools.repair_hint: Superseded by computer-use-linux; do not use Windows-specific window inspection.

priority_tools.name: rclone
priority_tools.repair_hint: rclone is a native CLI on both Claude and Codex sessions (pacman-installed on odin); no bridge needed.

priority_tools.name: yt-dlp
priority_tools.repair_hint: yt-dlp is a native CLI on both Claude and Codex sessions (pacman-installed on odin); no bridge needed.

priority_tools.name: cdrskin
priority_tools.repair_hint: cdrskin is a native CLI on both Claude and Codex sessions (pacman-installed on odin); no bridge needed. cd-info (libcdio) is the paired TOC-readback tool for post-burn verification.

priority_tools.name: fleet
priority_tools.repair_hint: Use the named SSH aliases (Tailscale SSH, batch mode) per Reference/fleet-access.md. Waking or restarting a host is user-gated.
